methods.label: Evaluate each power
methods.explanation:
Evaluate the powers before adding. Since the base is negative, the odd power is negative and the even power is positive:
\[
(-2)^{11}+(-2)^{10}=-2048+1024=-1024.
\]
methods.levelReason: This alternative uses Grade 7 power calculations, sign rules, and signed addition.
